newsitem.title: UK: Police hunt armed woman in London court drama.
newsitem.headline: Police hunt armed woman in London court drama.

text.p: Armed police were called in to hunt a woman who witnesses said pointed a pistol at a judge during a court hearing in London on Thursday.
The woman stood up and shouted "I have been assaulted and I have waited long enough" before pointing the weapon at Lord Justice Roy Beldam, witnesses said.
Police said: "She appeared from the public gallery with what appeared to be a handgun."
There were unconfirmed reports that the gun was in fact a plastic replica.
The woman, described as slim and in her early 20s, disappeared into the maze of corridors behind Court 7 at London's Law Courts.
The central London court complex was sealed off and police stopped anyone trying to leave or enter the building.
